title: jashne meelaade askari hai aaj
body:
jashne meelaade askari hai aaj
din mubarak hai shubh ghadi hai aaj
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj aaya jo gyaarwa masoom
chaai kounain par khushi hai aaj
<<DIVIDER>>
ruqe zeba ke saamne pheka
rooe khursheed qaadri hai aaj
<<DIVIDER>>
hai hassan aur hum shabihe hassan
jalwae husne haashmi hai aj
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhna robe dilbare hyder
dono aalm me tharthari hai aaj
<<DIVIDER>>
hai yahi ab ameene kouno makaa'n
in ke qabze me daawari hai aaj
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj hai jo duroode paake hassan
qalbe dushman me abtari hai aaj
